errorCodes.meaning: `identifier` is not one the VTA would collect for in `contextId`, whether or not collection by default is enabled (VTI-NTF-093): the VTA does not hold its messaging keys there, its DID document advertises no transport through a mediator, or it is the VTA's own durable identity, another node's or host service's, or an identity the VTA provisioned for another party, each of which its own holder collects for (VTI-NTF-080).

Another client holds a collection claim for the identifier that is in force. The VTA grants at most one claim per identifier (VTI-NTF-081, VTI-NTF-082). The other claim can be released with vta/collection/release, after which it still ends at its end; the identifier can be claimed once it has.

The caller's own claim for the identifier was released by another party, and ends at its end without renewal (VTI-NTF-084). The caller stops collecting before that end, and may claim the identifier again once it has ended.

schema.description: A client with standing in a trust context asks its VTA to make it, until a stated end, the one collector of the messages queued at the mediator for an identifier whose keys the VTA holds there — a persona DID — or renews a claim it already holds. Before it grants, the VTA stops collecting for the identifier and closes every connection it holds for it; the client opens its own only once it holds the grant, and closes it before the claim ends unless it has renewed (VTI-NTF-081 – VTI-NTF-083). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

durationSeconds.description: How long the client asks the claim to last from the grant. The VTA grants no longer than the maximum it states, and may grant less; absent, it grants its own default. The granted end is `endsAt` in the response.

identifier.description: The identifier to collect for: one whose messaging keys the VTA holds in `contextId` and whose DID document advertises a transport through a mediator.
